Unchanged original limits and 60-second read inactivity; streaming has different total-duration behavior.
Owned API complete shutdown and Gemma unload after each cell; review is GET-only and provider-guarded.
Keep every outcome, explicit unknown usage and timing scope; no production change, causal/held-out or release claim.
